title: Warm Wilted Greek Cabbage Moussaka
description: A flavorful and comforting Greek dish featuring wilted cabbage leaves and a crispy long-fermentation-dough crust.
instructions: Blanch the cabbage leaves in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Chill the cabbage leaves in an ice bath.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the wilted cabbage leaves and cook until heated through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Roll out the long-fermentation dough to fit a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Place the dough in the baking dish and trim the edges.
Spread the wilted cabbage mixture over the dough.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
